environment.description: Kubernetes deployment across 3 replicas in namespace 'prod-services'. All pods mount the same ConfigMap 'auth-config' containing SERVICE_SIGNING_KEY. The CDN_BASE_URL points to an internal CDN (cdn.internal.corp.net) served via nginx without content verification. No Content-Security-Policy headers configured on the ingress. The signing key 'k8s-shared-secret-2024-prod' has been the same since initial deployment (no rotation). Dashboard HTML serves scripts without integrity attributes.

config.cdn: nginx reverse proxy without content hash verification
